fullDescription: A high-energy, maximalist design system dubbed 'NeonSpace', characterized by vibrant gradients, Neobrutalist borders, and glassmorphic overlays. Featuring a striking purple-pink-orange color palette, this style is optimized for creative SaaS platforms, collaborative whiteboards, fintech dashboards for Gen-Z, and energetic productivity tools. It utilizes heavy typography (Cabinet Grotesk) and high-contrast UI elements with hard shadows and intentional tilts to create a playful, 'lived-in' digital environment.
prompt:
## Resumo
A maximalist collaborative dashboard featuring a vibrant 135-degree gradient background (#7c3aed to #db2777 to #f59e0b), thick 4px black borders, and glassmorphic panels with 16px backdrop blur. The design uses Neobrutalist 'hard' shadows and varied typography sizes to create a dynamic, creative workspace.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a 'NeonSpace' maximalist aesthetic. Background: fixed 135deg gradient from #7c3aed (0%), #db2777 (50%), to #f59e0b (100%). Typography: Headers in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (900 weight, italic, tracking-tight); Body in 'Satoshi' (400-700 weight). Component styling: Use 4px solid black borders for containers and 2px black borders for smaller items. Buttons: Neobrutalist style with shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)], translate to [2px, 2px] on hover while removing shadow. Overlays: Glassmorphism with background rgba(255,255,255,0.1), backdrop-filter blur(16px), and 1px white border at 25% opacity. Accents: Neon Lime (#bef264) for primary actions and success states; Neon Pink (#f472b6) for path strokes and secondary indicators.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Header
Height: 80px. Background: #18181b (Zinc-900). Border: 4px solid black bottom-border. Left side: Logo in a #bef264 box rotated -2deg with black text. Center: Breadcrumbs or project titles in bold italicized Cabinet Grotesk. Right side: User avatar stack with 2px black borders and two high-contrast CTA buttons ('Share' in white, 'Export' in Neon Lime) using 4px offset hard shadows.

### Left Utility Toolbar
Width: 96px. Background: #18181b. Border: 4px solid black right-border. Features a glassmorphic inner panel (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) containing vertical tool buttons. Top tool should be active with #bef264 background. Bottom section: Vertical stack of color picker circles (Pink #ec4899, Emerald #34d399, Amber #fbbf24) with 'neon-glow' shadows.

### Central Collaborative Canvas
Background: #ffffff. Texture: Radial-gradient dotted grid (rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) spaced at 24px. Elements: Include tilted sticky notes (Yellow #fef08a, rotated -3deg, 8px black shadow). Draggable image assets with 4px black borders and 12px offset purple shadows. Animated cursors with name tags (e.g., 'MAX_DESIGNER') following user paths.

### Right Utility Sidebar
Width: 384px. Background: Glassmorphic (rgba(255,255,255,0.1) with 16px blur). Border: 4px solid black left-border. Top Section: 'Team Sync' list with activity indicators. Bottom Section: 'Live Chat' with message bubbles using colored left-borders (Pink #f472b6 for others, Lime #bef264 for 'You'). Input: Black field with 2px Zinc-700 border, turning Neon Lime on focus.

### Floating Bottom Controls
Positioned absolute bottom-12, centered. Style: Rounded-full glassmorphic pill. Features: Zoom controls (e.g., '128%') and Undo/Redo buttons. Use icons from Lucide/Iconify set at 24px size.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neobrutalist Sticky Note — A tilted, high-contrast digital post-it note.
Background #fef08a. Border: 2px solid black. Rotation: -3deg. Shadow: 8px 8px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). Hover state: transform rotate(0deg) scale(1.05). Content: 18px font-black header with a 14px secondary text area and a footer showing user avatar/timestamp.

### Glassmorphic Chat Bubble — Highly legible chat interface component within a blurred sidebar.
Container: rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for others, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) for current user. Border-left: 4px solid (#f472b6 or #bef264). Padding: 16px. Typography: 10px uppercase bold sender name, 12px leading-relaxed white text body.

style.description: Maximalist/Neobrutalist hybrid theme. Typography uses 'Cabinet Grotesk' for heavy, black-weight headers and 'Satoshi' for functional UI. Colors are anchored by a #7c3aed to #f59e0b gradient, with #bef264 (Neon Lime) and #f472b6 (Neon Pink) as primary interactive accents. Animation includes bouncy transitions (cubic-bezier 0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) and cursor-following movements.
